The agent opened the site and found the search page The user asked the agent to book the flight. The agent opened: ```text http://localhost:5173/ ``` The browser returned a page target successfully. The agent took an accessibility snapshot of the homepage. The snapshot showed: - GKD Airlines navigation - a “Flight Search” link - “My Bookings” - “Baggage Tracking” - “Restaurant Info” - “Airport Info” - a signed-in user link labeled “Peter” - a prominent “Search Flights” link The agent attempted to click the “Search Flights” link using: ```json {"action": "click", "ref": "e19"} ``` The browser tool rejected this with a validation error saying the `action` value was not allowed. The agent then retried with: ```json {"action": "act", "kind": "click", "ref": "e19"} ``` This returned `ok: true`. A follow-up snapshot showed the flight search form. ### 2. The agent reached the flight search form The search page snapshot showed fields for: - Origin Airport, textbox placeholder `e.g., JFK` - Destination Airport, textbox placeholder `e.g., LAX` - Departure Date - Passengers, default `1 Passenger` - Cabin Class, default `Economy` - Search Flights button At this point the agent sent a visible message saying it would fill: - Origin: JFK - Destination: LAX - Date: next Monday, which it stated as “April 7, 2026” - Cabin: Economy, already selected The trajectory then shows the agent trying to fill the origin field. ### 3. Form-filling attempts began failing The agent first tried: ```json {"action": "act", "kind": "fill", "ref": "e75", "text": "JFK"} ``` The browser tool returned: ```text "error": "fields are required" ``` The agent then tried several variants: ```json {"action": "request", "kind": "fill", "ref": "e75", "text": "JFK"} ``` This was rejected because `request` was not an allowed browser action. It then tried: ```json {"action": "request", "fields": [{"ref": "e75", "text": "JFK"}], "kind": "fill"} ``` This was also rejected because `request` was not an allowed browser action. It then went back to: ```json {"action": "act", "kind": "fill", "ref": "e75", "text": "JFK"} ``` and again received: ```text "error": "fields are required" ``` The agent said it needed to check the browser schema, but instead navigated directly to `/search` and took another snapshot. The new snapshot showed the same form, with new refs: - origin field `e24` - destination field `e27` - date field `e30` - passengers `e33` - cabin class `e36` - search button `e37` It then tried: ```json {"action": "request", "text": "JFK", "kind": "type", "ref": "e24"} ``` The browser again rejected `request` as an invalid action. ### 4. It tried to run a Node script using Puppeteer: ```bash cd /root/.openclaw/workspace && node -e "const puppeteer = require('puppeteer'); ..." ``` The command failed because Puppeteer was not installed: ```text Error: Cannot find module 'puppeteer' ``` The agent then tried a browser `eval` action: ```json { "action": "eval", "javaScript": "document.querySelector('[ref=\"e24\"]').value = 'JFK'; ..." } ``` The browser tool rejected `eval` as an invalid action. It then tried a `canvas` eval action using the browser target ID: ```json { "action": "eval", "node": "BFF3DB7702503DCC5A0C0D425404DE14", "javaScript": "document.querySelector('[ref=\"e24\"]').value = 'JFK'; ..." } ``` The canvas tool returned: ```text "error": "unknown node: BFF3DB7702503DCC5A0C0D425404DE14" ``` ### 5.
